revenue_mm.source_text: Natural gas stream only: 1017370-1017370 MMcf annual volume x $2.73-$2.83/Mcf realized price
revenue_mm.note: This is AR's GAS-STREAM revenue only, not total company revenue. Ethane, C3+ NGL, and oil volumes are computed (see inputs_used.annual_volume_split) but are NOT priced or included here — this repo has no Mont Belvieu benchmark price (needed for ethane/NGL) and no WTI spot price (needed for oil) anywhere in market-data.json. See inputs_used.excluded_streams for the sourced differentials that exist and are ready to use once those benchmarks are added.

ebitdax_mm.source_text: revenue_mm ($2777.4-$2879.2MM, gas-stream only) minus cash_unit_cost_total ($2.38-$2.52/Mcfe) x gas volume only (1017.4-1017.4 Bcf, NOT total production) = $2421.3-$2563.8MM
ebitdax_mm.note: Gas-only Revenue minus gas-only share of costs (cash_unit_cost_total applied to gas volume only, not total production, to keep revenue/cost on the same basis). Assumes AR's blended per-Mcfe cost rate applies uniformly across gas/NGL/oil — may not hold exactly. Ethane/C3+NGL/oil revenue and cost shares excluded entirely, same reasons as revenue_mm.

annual_production_bcfe.source_text: 4.1-4.1 Bcfe/d x 365 days (2026 is not a leap year)

q1_2026_actual_commodity_mix.conversion_factor_note: 6 Mcf-equivalent per Bbl applied to ethane/C3+NGL/oil MBbl figures; recomputed combined total (347.144 Bcfe) matches AR's own disclosed combined total (347 Bcfe) within 0.144 Bcfe — confirms the conversion factor rather than assuming it.

computed_mix_ratios.note: Volume split applies AR's actual Q1 2026 commodity mix (from 10-Q) to 2026 full-year guided production — mix may shift over the year, not a company disclosure.

henry_hub_spot.source_text: data/market-data.json henry_hub_daily_spot_price_usd_per_mmbtu, most recent date available

natural_gas_differential.source_text: Natural Gas Differential | +$0.10 to +$0.20/Mcf vs. NYMEX Henry Hub

gas_price_per_mcf.source_text: Henry Hub spot $2.63/MMBtu (2026-07-27, data/market-data.json) + AR guided natural gas differential +$0.1-$0.2/Mcf vs. NYMEX Henry Hub (data/differentials_normalized.json)
gas_price_per_mcf.note: Henry Hub is quoted in $/MMBtu; this treats $/MMBtu as numerically equal to $/Mcf per common industry shorthand. Pipeline-quality natural gas is typically ~1.02-1.035 MMBtu per Mcf, so this introduces a small, un-adjusted ~2-4% approximation — not a Btu-content-adjusted price.

cash_unit_cost_total.source_text: 2026 Cash Production Expense: $2.25–$2.35/Mcfe + Cash G&A: $0.11–$0.13/Mcfe + Net Marketing Expense: $0.02–$0.04/Mcfe (summed by this script — see classification)
cash_unit_cost_total.note: AR bundles LOE+GP&T+taxes into one line; not directly comparable to peers who report these separately.

differential.source_text: Ethane Differential | Updated indication: +$2.00 to +$3.00/bbl vs. Mont Belvieu (Prior: +$1.00 to +$2.00/bbl)
differential.note: Requires direct company-source verification before model input — AR's own source text flags this as an indication, not confirmed guidance. Do not use for Layer 3 forecasting until independently verified.

ethane.excluded_because: Ethane volume is computed in annual_volume_split, and AR's own guided differential exists in differentials_normalized.json, but this repo has no Mont Belvieu benchmark spot price anywhere — so ethane is excluded from revenue_mm entirely, not estimated.

differential.source_text: C3+ NGL Differential | ($0.50) to +$0.50/bbl vs. Mont Belvieu
differential.note: AR discloses a C3+ NGL differential (propane-plus only), not a blanket NGL differential like RRC's — narrower scope, not directly comparable to RRC's ngl_differential.

c3_plus_ngl.excluded_because: C3+ NGL volume is computed in annual_volume_split, and AR's own guided differential exists in differentials_normalized.json, but this repo has no Mont Belvieu benchmark spot price anywhere — so c3+ ngl is excluded from revenue_mm entirely, not estimated.

oil.excluded_because: Oil volume is computed in annual_volume_split, and AR's own guided differential exists in differentials_normalized.json, but this repo has no WTI benchmark spot price anywhere — so oil is excluded from revenue_mm entirely, not estimated.
